name: doc_list
description: List all open FreeCAD documents.

name: doc_create
description: Create a new empty document. `name` is the internal id, `label` is the display name.

name: doc_recompute
description: Recompute the document and return any errors found.

name: expr_set
description:
Bind a property to a FreeCAD expression.

Examples:
  expr_set("Pad", "Length", "Spreadsheet.wall_thickness * 2")
  expr_set("Box", "Width", "Box.Length / 2")

name: expr_get
description: Return all expression bindings on an object.

name: expr_clear
description: Remove the expression binding on a property.

name: io_import_step
description: Import a STEP file into the active (or named) document.

name: io_import_iges
description: Import an IGES file into the active (or named) document.

name: io_export_step
description: Export objects to STEP. If `names` is omitted, exports the whole document.

name: io_export_iges
description: Export objects to IGES.

name: io_export_stl
description: Export objects to STL (mesh). Use for 3D printing pipelines.

name: io_export_obj
description: Export objects to OBJ (mesh).

name: obj_list
description: List objects in a document (active doc if `doc` omitted). Returns name/label/type only.

name: obj_get
description: Return a compact summary of one object (name, label, type, placement, shape validity).

name: obj_get_tree
description: Return the dependency tree (each object's InList/OutList) for the document.

name: obj_get_properties
description: Return all properties of an object as a flat dict. Use sparingly — payload can be large.

name: obj_set_property
description: Set a single property on an object and recompute.

name: obj_delete
description: Delete an object from its document.

name: obj_set_placement
description: Set placement. `pos` is [x,y,z]; `rotation` is [yaw,pitch,roll] degrees or [ax,ay,az,deg].

name: obj_set_label
description: Change an object's display label.

name: part_box
description: Create a Part::Box. Dimensions in document units (mm by default).

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: part_cylinder
description: Create a Part::Cylinder. Use `angle` < 360 for a wedge.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: part_sphere
description: Create a Part::Sphere. angle1/angle2 cap latitude; angle3 sweeps longitude.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: part_cone
description: Create a Part::Cone (truncated if radius1 != radius2).

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: part_torus
description: Create a Part::Torus. radius1 = ring radius; radius2 = tube radius.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: part_plane
description: Create a flat Part::Plane face.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: part_extrude
description: Extrude a 2D profile (sketch/wire/face) along `direction` for `length`.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: part_revolve
description: Revolve a profile around `axis` through `base_point` for `angle` degrees.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: part_loft
description: Loft through a list of section profiles (by name).

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: part_sweep
description: Sweep a profile along a path.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: part_fuse
description: Boolean union: base ∪ tool.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: part_cut
description: Boolean difference: base − tool.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: part_common
description: Boolean intersection: base ∩ tool.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: part_fillet
description: Fillet (round) selected edges of `base`. `edges` are 1-based edge indices.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: part_chamfer
description: Chamfer selected edges of `base`. `edges` are 1-based edge indices.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: part_mirror
description: Mirror an object across a plane defined by `normal` through `base_point`.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: part_pattern_linear
description: Linear array of `source` along `direction` with `count` copies spaced `interval` apart.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: part_pattern_polar
description: Polar array of `source` around `axis` through `center` for total `angle` degrees.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: pd_create_body
description: Create a new PartDesign Body. Features are added to one Body at a time.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: pd_pad
description: Pad (extrude) a sketch profile inside a Body. `midplane` extrudes symmetrically.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: pd_pocket
description: Pocket (subtract by extruding) a sketch profile inside a Body.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: pd_revolution
description: Revolve a profile around an axis to create a solid feature on a Body.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: pd_groove
description: Groove (subtractive revolution) a profile around an axis.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: pd_fillet
description: Fillet edges on a Body feature. `edges` are sub-names like ['Edge1', 'Edge3'].

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: pd_chamfer
description: Chamfer edges on a Body feature. `edges` are sub-names like ['Edge1', 'Edge3'].

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: pd_pattern_linear
description: Linear pattern of features on a Body.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: pd_pattern_polar
description: Polar pattern of features on a Body.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: pd_mirrored
description: Mirror features across a plane (normal + base point) on a Body.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: sheet_create
description:
Create a Spreadsheet object. Pair with sheet_set_cell + sheet_set_alias to expose
cells as named parameters that expr_set can reference.

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: sheet_set_cell
description:
Set a cell. `cell` is A1-style ('A1', 'B3'). `value` is a string:
number ('12.5'), formula ('=A1*2'), text ('hello').

name: sheet_get_cell
description: Get a cell's raw contents and evaluated value.

name: sheet_set_alias
description: Alias a cell so expressions can reference it as `<SheetLabel>.<alias>`.

name: sketch_create

label.description: Unique ASCII object ID; use obj_set_label for human display labels.

name: sketch_add_line
description: Add a line segment to a sketch. Points are 2D [x, y] in sketch coordinates.

name: sketch_add_circle
description: Add a circle to a sketch.

name: sketch_add_arc
description: Add a circular arc to a sketch. Angles in degrees from +X axis, CCW.

name: sketch_add_point
description: Add an isolated point to a sketch.

name: sketch_add_polyline
description:
Add a chain of connected line segments. Auto-adds Coincident constraints between
consecutive endpoints. If `closed`, closes the polyline back to the first point.

name: sketch_add_constraint
description:
Add a constraint to a sketch.

`kind` is one of: Coincident, Horizontal, Vertical, Parallel, Perpendicular,
Tangent, Equal, Symmetric, Block, Distance, DistanceX, DistanceY, Radius,
Diameter, Angle, PointOnObject.

`refs` flattens (geo_index, point_index) pairs:
  - For "the curve itself", point_index = 0
  - Endpoints: 1 = start, 2 = end (for line/arc); 3 = center (arc/circle)
  - Coincident([3, 2, 5, 1]) = end of geo3 coincident with start of geo5

`value` required for dimensional constraints (Distance*, Radius, Diameter, Angle).
Lengths in mm, angles in degrees.

name: sketch_set_constraint_value
description:
Change the driving value of an existing dimensional constraint. Lengths in mm,
angles in degrees.

name: sketch_list_geometry
description: List all geometry in a sketch with index, type, and key parameters.

name: sketch_list_constraints
description: List all constraints in a sketch with index, type, refs, and value (if dimensional).

name: sketch_delete_geometry
description: Delete geometry elements by index.

name: sketch_delete_constraint
description: Delete constraints by index.

name: view_set_view
description: Switch the active 3D view direction. `direction` ∈ iso, top, bottom, front, rear, left, right.

name: view_fit_all
description: Zoom-fit all visible objects in the active 3D view.
